summary: Enabling Rails' parallelize configuration in test cases causes a crash in the Ruby SDK's test worker, manifesting as a [BUG] in dyld with a segmentation fault on M1 Macs running Ruby 4.0.1.
userImpact: Users cannot use Rails parallel testing configuration with the Temporal Ruby SDK without experiencing a runtime crash.
rootCause: Test worker crash in Ruby 4.0+ when parallel test execution is enabled, likely due to memory corruption or threading issues in dyld.
keyQuote: Enabling parallelize in test cases triggers a crash
